expandedSheet.construction: nearest-neighbour upscale of four native frames

notes: The native strip is 128x64 and contains four 32x64 cells. The expanded strip is 256x128 with four 64x128 cells.
QA checks the pixel indices in each expanded cell against the corresponding native frame scaled by nearest-neighbour.
Shared palette and transparent index 34 are used across all frames.
Art is a staging draft; idle variations are subtle and will be checked during the final cross-class polish.
